exampleEn: We all need to pitch in to make this project a success.
exampleKo: 우리는 이 프로젝트를 성공시키기 위해 모두가 도움을 줘야 해.
gameExamples: If everyone can pitch in, we will finish the task much faster.
During the fundraiser, many local businesses decided to pitch in with donations.
I appreciate it when team members are willing to pitch in to help each other.
